verdicts.note: The reform axis is money and power in politics (PAC money, term limits, dark-money bans, RCV, direct democracy). The cited evidence [S1][S2][S3] is an election-administration agenda: voter-roll audits with AI, voter ID with proof of citizenship, election-night results and no late-arriving ballots. None of it concerns campaign money, term limits, voting systems or direct democracy, so it does not place him on this axis in either direction. His campaign was self-funded before the primary [S6], which is not a stated reform position either.
